$comment: The minimum conditions of Annex A Part D. ENGLISH GOVERNS (partner ruling, 2026-09-01): the earlier build carried the UNION of the English and Arabic issues -- eleven months of 'ten conditions' -- because the two issues disagree on one row: English Part D has 'Nightclub or dance venue licensed for 1,000 or more' (club) where the Arabic issue generalizes the same row to any venue regularly hosting organized events (recur). The partner ruled the English issue's content is what is built, so recur is REMOVED and the nine English rows stand. The venue INSTRUMENT (annual classification of recurring venues, Protocol 3.1) is unaffected -- that criterion is English text; only the event-side minimum condition goes. Each row's `issue` tag is provenance and is no longer rendered. `derivation` is the build's own -- the prototype used manual checkboxes for seven of these (non-negotiable #0). reasonEn/reasonAr are the lay one-line explanations the result panel shows; they live beside the thresholds they describe so a Ministry threshold edit updates both in one row.

expectedMaxSimultaneousAttendance.noteEn: Captured as a number. Domain 1's top option is '10,000 or more', which spans both the Level 2 and the Level 3 floor -- the floor resolves from this number, never from the domain answer.

eventDisciplines.noteEn: Structured list. Domain 2's top option bundles six disciplines carrying different floors; the floor resolves from this list, never from the domain answer.

courseDistanceKm.noteEn: Required field on organized running events. An optional field left blank on a marathon returns Level 2.

conditions.ar: أي فعالية يبلغ فيها الحد الأقصى للحضور المتزامن من 10,000 إلى 19,999 شخصاً
conditions.reasonEn: Because between 10,000 and 19,999 people are expected at the same time.
conditions.reasonAr: لأنه يُتوقّع حضور ما بين 10,000 و19,999 شخصاً في الوقت نفسه.

conditions.en: 20,000 or more present at the same time
conditions.ar: أي فعالية يبلغ فيها الحد الأقصى للحضور المتزامن 20,000 شخص أو أكثر
conditions.reasonEn: Because 20,000 or more people are expected at the same time.
conditions.reasonAr: لأنه يُتوقّع حضور 20,000 شخص أو أكثر في الوقت نفسه.

conditions.en: Nightclub or dance venue licensed for 1,000 or more
conditions.ar: ملهى ليلي أو صالة رقص مرخصة لـ 1,000 أو أكثر
conditions.reasonEn: Because the venue is a nightclub or dance venue licensed for 1,000 or more.
conditions.reasonAr: لأن الموقع ملهى ليلي أو صالة رقص مرخّصة لـ1,000 شخص أو أكثر.

conditions.reasonEn: Because it includes an organized running event.

conditions.en: Organized running event with a course of 21.1 km or more
conditions.ar: فعالية جري منظمة يبلغ طول مسارها 21.1 كيلومتراً أو أكثر
conditions.reasonEn: Because it includes a running course of 21.1 km or more.
conditions.reasonAr: لأنها تتضمن مسار جري بطول 21.1 كلم أو أكثر.

conditions.ar: فعالية سباحة منظمة في المياه المفتوحة
conditions.reasonEn: Because it includes organized open-water swimming.
conditions.reasonAr: لأنها تتضمن سباحة منظمة في المياه المفتوحة.

conditions.en: Boxing, kickboxing, Muay Thai or mixed martial arts competition
conditions.ar: مسابقة ملاكمة، أو كيك بوكسينغ، أو مواي تاي، أو فنون قتالية مختلطة
conditions.reasonEn: Because it includes a boxing, kickboxing, Muay Thai or mixed martial arts competition.
conditions.reasonAr: لأنها تتضمن منافسة في الملاكمة أو الكيك بوكسينغ أو المواي تاي أو الفنون القتالية المختلطة.

conditions.reasonEn: Because it includes competitive motor racing.

reasons.$comment: The result panel's why-lines when no single condition governs. {score} interpolates the total; {level} the level.
reasons.scoreEn: Because the answers add up to {score} points.
reasons.bothEn: The points and a minimum condition both give this level.
reasons.bothAr: يعطي مجموع النقاط وأحد الحدود الدنيا هذا المستوى نفسه.
reasons.comparisonEn: Points: Level {scoreLevel}. Minimum condition: Level {conditionLevel}. The higher applies.
reasons.comparisonAr: النقاط: المستوى {scoreLevel}. الحد الأدنى: المستوى {conditionLevel}. ويُعتمد الأعلى.
reasons.scoreOnlyEn: Points: Level {scoreLevel}. No minimum condition applies.
reasons.scoreOnlyAr: النقاط: المستوى {scoreLevel}. ولا ينطبق أي حد أدنى.
